description:
The process begins when a company identifies the need for a new supplier or vendor.
The procurement team issues a request for proposals (RFP) and receives responses from various suppliers.
Each proposal is evaluated based on criteria like cost, quality, and delivery time.
The team may also conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers.
After careful analysis, a supplier is selected, and contract negotiations begin.
Once both parties agree on the terms, the contract is signed.
The process ends when the supplier is officially onboarded, and the contract is executed.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_SupplierSelection" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-selection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierSelection" name="Supplier Selection and Onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ProcessStarted" name="Process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeed" name="Identify need for new supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals (RFP)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveResponses" name="Receive supplier responses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals by cost, quality and delivery time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitsSplit" name="Site visits or interviews needed?" default="Flow_7">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VisitsInterviews" name="Conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitsJoin" name="Evaluation continues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyseSelectSupplier" name="Analyse results and select supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier and execute contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Onboarded" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ProcessStarted" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeed" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveResponses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveResponses" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_VisitsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" name="Visits or interviews" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitsSplit" targetRef="Task_VisitsInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" name="No visits or interviews" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_VisitsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_VisitsInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_VisitsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitsJoin" targetRef="Task_AnalyseSelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_AnalyseSelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateContract" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="EndEvent_Onboarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
